name: Business Layer
description: Depicts business services offered to customers, which are realised in the organisation by business processes performed by business actors.

name: Application Layer
description: Depicts application services that support the business, and the applications that realise them.

name: Technology Layer
description: Depicts technology services such as processing, storage, and communication services needed to run the applications, and the computer and communication hardware and system software that realise those services.

name: Strategy Layer
description: Provides elements for modelling the strategic direction and choices of the enterprise.

name: Motivation Layer
description: Provides elements for modelling the motivations, or reasons, that guide the design or change of an enterprise architecture.
